headline: Maui Police Commission

meeting.summary: The Maui Police Commission heard an undercover operation led to four arrests and voted to seek a 5% raise for the chief.
meeting.recap: From April 10 to 12, police and partner agencies ran an undercover operation that led to four arrests.[[0:07:25]] As of April 30, the county had two traffic deaths this year, compared to eight last year.[[0:18:23]] Compared to last year, murders, rapes and robberies are down, but assaults are up 16%.[[0:47:35]] The chief said the fires make year-to-year crime comparisons unfair.[[0:48:57]] A fallen officer's name is now etched on the national memorial in Washington, D.C.[[0:55:18]] The commission has a list of 11 applicants for its new investigator position.[[1:04:50]] A commissioner suggested an ethics opinion because the investigator will fall under the police department.[[1:07:58]] The chair proposed a rule letting the commission skip complaints the department already settled through its faster rapid adjudication process.[[1:17:51]] The salary commission has suggested a 3.5% raise for the chief.[[1:29:32]] The chair asked for a motion to send a letter suggesting a 5% raise for the chief.[[1:32:55]] The commission approved the letter with eight yeses.[[1:35:38]] After a closed-door executive session, the commission deferred the rule change to its next meeting.[[1:39:16]] The commission reported approving legal representation requests from officers and from a chief.[[1:40:14]] The next meeting is June 17 at 10 a.m.[[1:41:06]]
decided: The letter of commendation was filed without objection.
The commission voted by roll call to continue the rules discussion in executive session (a closed-door discussion).
The commission agreed by unanimous consent to take up item eight next.
The commission deferred the rule changes and will continue the discussion at its next meeting.
The commission deferred item 9A to its next meeting to get more information and review the complaint.
The commission voted to allow legal representation for a chief who requested it.
meeting.next: The chief plans a strategic plan update in next month's chief's report. The deputy chief said the department will look for a space for the investigator separate from police. The chair will send a letter to the salary commission with the commission's recommendations. The rule change discussion will continue at the next meeting.
